editorial:
Imagine a world where simply looking outside can kill you. An unseen force drives people to suicide the moment they see it, so survivors must navigate blindfolded. Sandra Bullock plays Malorie, a tough mother trying to get her two kids to safety down a dangerous river. The story jumps between her present journey and flashbacks of how the chaos began. It feels tense and scary, with danger around every corner. You'll feel the fear right alongside the characters as they stumble through a world they can no longer see.

The acting is strong, especially Bullock's raw and emotional performance. The pacing keeps you on edge, and the blindfolded action scenes are genuinely nerve-wracking. On the downside, some side characters feel underdeveloped, and the ending may feel a bit rushed. Still, if you enjoy survival thrillers with a unique twist, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Malorie and the kids reach a safe community hidden inside an old school for the blind. The people there survived because they were already blind, so the creatures cannot affect them. Malorie finally names her children, Tom and Olympia, showing she has learned to love and hope again. The twist is that safety was always with those who could not see the danger at all.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival thrillers with a unique twist.
